title: suslifepath-paper0: collision-risk index toolchain and catalogue snapshot

creators.name: Toson, Federico
creators.affiliation: CISAS "G. Colombo", University of Padova, Italy

description: MATLAB toolchain reproducing the numerical results, figures and tables of the companion manuscript on a simplified engineering algorithm for collision risk assessment and classification of LEO satellites, from a May 2026 Celestrak General Perturbations catalogue snapshot. Version 2.1.0 adds the evaluation across the whole catalogue (14 727 active LEO objects), the Sentinel-6 end-of-life options and the collision-avoidance sensitivity of the revision for Advances in Space Research.
